_comment: Build-time allowlist for <ProductLink ref="...">. Each key is `creator-ops:<product id>` -- creator-ops identifies products by a plain NocoDB integer row id (its Products table has no slug/ASIN column; ASIN lives per-platform on a separate Links table, since one product can have multiple platform links). This is a manually-maintained subset, not a live catalog sync -- see src/components/blog/ProductLink.astro and report section 2 (data/btsbs-redesign-1/report.md) for the full design. When curating an entry, pick the specific Links row's affiliate URL for the platform you want this card to point to. Remove this placeholder entry once a real product is added.
